qualification.resident_six: CORRECTNESS-UNQUALIFIED: output differs from both file controls; configured MTP produced zero verified drafts. Do not accept its speed as valid inference performance.
qualification.defect: Released embed.comp uses uint byte addressing for quantized resident rows. At width160 IQ4_NL, row offsets wrap beyond4GiB; the full table is28,800,138,240bytes. File lookup uses wide host offsets and uploads remapped small row packs.
qualification.reproducer: Completed failing-first Vulkan regression on the released runtime at commit f984840a461de65b12b5ea247d64e5b7e7483997; evidence is committed as 6a3adff52fe8d3da76bff750feb2f5c4b4dd32d2 in worktrees/vulkan-large-lookup-20261020/docs/benchmarks/vulkan-large-lookup-repro-20261020.json. Host-ID gather: 480 of 480 high-row values mismatch; device-ID gather: 480 of 480 high-row values mismatch. Low-row controls and invalid device-ID zero rows pass. Exact high-row byte offset 4294968660 wraps to 1364. The full-table descriptor also exceeds maxStorageBufferRange (4294967295); widening shader arithmetic alone does not solve both constraints. This is a failing-first reproducer, not a fix or HF qualification.
qualification.warmup: Repeated prompt warms its selected rows, not every table page; no page-touch patch was applied.
